Go to Bill Details and export the bill to view token usage.

Text generation is billed by the number of tokens for input and output.

Image generation is billed by the number of images successfully generated.

Video generation is billed by the number of video seconds successfully generated.

Free-quota data displayed in the console may be delayed.

Native generation usage has input_tokens and output_tokens. Detailed fields are input_tokens_details.text_tokens, input_tokens_details.image_tokens, input_tokens_details.video_tokens, output_tokens_details.text_tokens, output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, and output_tokens_details.audio_tokens. Some models instead expose top-level image_tokens, video_tokens, or audio_tokens. Cache fields are prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.cache_creation_input_tokens plus prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens. Streaming and non-streaming responses use the same usage fields. Cache creation fields are absent when explicit caching is not used. Requests may set parameters.enable_thinking.

Image results expose usage.image_count, usage.width, usage.height, and usage.size.

Video results expose usage.video_duration, usage.duration, usage.input_video_duration, usage.output_video_duration, usage.SR, usage.size, and usage.video_count. Requests may set prompt_extend.

TTS results expose characters, input_tokens_details.text_tokens, and output_tokens_details.audio_tokens. Music results expose usage.duration.

ASR results may expose usage.duration or usage.seconds. Streaming ASR sentence_end events expose payload.output.usage.duration.
